# Reusable blocks

## Contents

- US postal address
- US bank account (direct deposit, vendor payment)
- Privacy notice with acknowledgement
- Typed-name attestation
- US states
- Anchored patterns

Field groups that recur across forms, as spec JSON. Copy a block into a page's `fields`, rename the
key prefix if the form needs two of them (`home_`, `mailing_`), and replace any <angle-bracket>
placeholder text with the organisation's own details.

## US bank account (direct deposit, vendor payment)

Holder, bank, ABA routing, account, a confirm field and checking/savings. The form cannot check that the two account numbers match; say so in the confirm field's help text, as here.

```json
[
  {
    "key": "payee_holder",
    "type": "text",
    "label": "Name on the account",
    "required": true,
    "description": "Exactly as the bank holds it."
  },
  {
    "key": "payee_bank",
    "type": "text",
    "label": "Bank name",
    "required": true,
    "example": "First National Bank"
  },
  {
    "key": "payee_routing",
    "type": "text",
    "label": "ABA routing number",
    "required": true,
    "pattern": {
      "regex": "^\\d{9}$",
      "message": "An ABA routing number is nine digits",
      "example": "021000021"
    },
    "description": "The nine-digit number at the bottom left of a check."
  },
  {
    "key": "payee_account",
    "type": "text",
    "label": "Account number",
    "required": true,
    "pattern": {
      "regex": "^\\d{4,17}$",
      "message": "Enter 4 to 17 digits, no spaces",
      "example": "000123456789"
    }
  },
  {
    "key": "payee_account_confirm",
    "type": "text",
    "label": "Confirm account number",
    "required": true,
    "pattern": {
      "regex": "^\\d{4,17}$",
      "message": "Enter 4 to 17 digits, no spaces",
      "example": "000123456789"
    },
    "description": "Type it again. The form cannot compare the two — Payroll and Accounts Payable check them by hand before the first payment."
  },
  {
    "key": "payee_type",
    "type": "radio",
    "label": "Account type",
    "options": [
      "Checking",
      "Savings"
    ],
    "required": true
  }
]
```


## Privacy notice with acknowledgement

A GDPR Art. 13 / CCPA notice-at-collection as a description block, plus a required acknowledgement.

```json
[
  {
    "key": "privacy_notice",
    "type": "description",
    "text": "**Privacy notice.** <Organisation legal name> is the controller of the personal data on this form. Contact: <privacy@example.com>.\n\n**What we collect:** <what the form collects, in plain words>\n\n**Why, and our lawful basis:** <why, and the lawful basis>\n\n**Who receives it:** <who receives it>\n\n**How long we keep it:** <how long it is kept>\n\n**Your rights:** you may ask for access to, correction or deletion of your data, ask us to restrict or stop using it, ask for a portable copy, and withdraw any consent at any time without affecting what was done before. You may also complain to the UK Information Commissioner's Office or the Irish Data Protection Commission.\n\n**California residents:** this is our notice at collection under the California Consumer Privacy Act. We collect the categories above for the purposes above, we do not sell or share them for cross-context behavioural advertising, and we keep them only as long as stated. You have the rights to know, delete, correct and limit the use of sensitive personal information, and we will not discriminate against you for using them."
  },
  {
    "key": "privacy_ack",
    "type": "checkbox",
    "label": "I have read the privacy notice above.",
    "options": [
      "I acknowledge"
    ],
    "required": true
  }
]
```


## Typed-name attestation

A standalone form has no signature field. This is the substitute: certification statements, ESIGN/UETA (and eIDAS) consent wording, an agreement box, a typed name and the date. If the use case needs a real Docusign signature, the form must be template-based instead, which cannot be imported.

```json
[
  {
    "key": "sign_statements",
    "type": "description",
    "text": "**By signing, you certify that:**\n\n- <The information I have given is true and complete.>"
  },
  {
    "key": "sign_consent",
    "type": "description",
    "text": "**Electronic signature and records.** By ticking the box, typing your full name and selecting Submit, you adopt your typed name as your electronic signature on this form. Under the US Electronic Signatures in Global and National Commerce Act (ESIGN) and the Uniform Electronic Transactions Act (UETA), it is as legally binding as a handwritten signature. If you are in the UK or the EU, it is an electronic signature within the meaning of the UK eIDAS Regulations and EU Regulation 910/2014 (eIDAS), and may be relied on as evidence. You consent to receive this record and notices about it electronically. To do so you need a device with a current web browser and the ability to save or print a PDF. You may ask for a paper copy, or withdraw consent to electronic records, at no charge by contacting <contact email>; withdrawing does not affect anything you have already submitted."
  },
  {
    "key": "sign_agree",
    "type": "checkbox",
    "label": "I agree to sign electronically, and I certify the statements above.",
    "options": [
      "I agree"
    ],
    "required": true
  },
  {
    "key": "sign_name",
    "type": "text",
    "label": "Type your full legal name as your signature",
    "required": true,
    "example": "Jordan Avery"
  },
  {
    "key": "sign_date",
    "type": "date",
    "label": "Date",
    "required": true
  }
]
```

## Anchored patterns

For a `text` field's `pattern` (`{ "regex", "message", "example" }`). Each is anchored `^…$` and its
example matches. In JSON, double each backslash.

| Name | Regex | Message | Example |
|---|---|---|---|
| `ukPostcode` | `^[A-Za-z]{1,2}\d[A-Za-z\d]? ?\d[A-Za-z]{2}$` | Enter a UK postcode, for example EC2A 4NE | `EC2A 4NE` |
| `eircode` | `^[A-Za-z]\d[\dWw] ?[A-Za-z0-9]{4}$` | Enter an Eircode, for example D02 X285 | `D02 X285` |
| `intlPostcode` | `^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9 -]{1,9}$` | Enter the postal code as it is written locally (letters, digits, spaces and hyphens) | `10115` |
| `usRouting` | `^\d{9}$` | An ABA routing number is nine digits | `021000021` |
| `usAccount` | `^\d{4,17}$` | Enter 4 to 17 digits, no spaces | `000123456789` |
| `sortCode` | `^\d{2}-?\d{2}-?\d{2}$` | Enter the sort code as 12-34-56 | `20-00-00` |
| `ukAccount` | `^\d{8}$` | A UK account number is eight digits | `31926819` |
| `iban` | `^[A-Z]{2}\d{2}[A-Z0-9]{11,30}$` | Enter the IBAN in capital letters with no spaces, for example IE29AIBK93115212345678 | `IE29AIBK93115212345678` |
| `bic` | `^[A-Z]{6}[A-Z0-9]{2}([A-Z0-9]{3})?$` | Enter the 8- or 11-character SWIFT/BIC in capital letters | `AIBKIE2D` |
| `ein` | `^\d{2}-\d{7}$` | Enter the EIN as 12-3456789 | `12-3456789` |
| `ukVat` | `^GB(\d{9}|\d{12})$` | Enter a UK VAT number as GB followed by 9 or 12 digits | `GB123456789` |
| `euVat` | `^[A-Z]{2}[A-Z0-9]{2,12}$` | Enter the VAT number with its two-letter country prefix, in capital letters and without spaces | `IE6388047V` |
| `companyNo` | `^([0-9]{8}|[A-Z]{2}[0-9]{6})$` | A Companies House number is 8 characters, for example 09876543 or SC123456 | `09876543` |
| `duns` | `^\d{9}$` | A D-U-N-S number is nine digits | `150483782` |
| `naics` | `^\d{6}$` | A NAICS code is six digits | `541512` |
| `niNumber` | `^[A-CEGHJ-PR-TW-Z]{2}\d{6}[A-D]$` | Enter your National Insurance number in capital letters, for example AB123456C | `AB123456C` |
| `ppsn` | `^\d{7}[A-W][A-IW]?$` | Enter your PPS number: seven digits and one or two capital letters | `1234567FA` |
| `time` | `^([01]\d|2[0-3]):[0-5]\d$` | Enter a 24-hour time as HH:MM, for example 14:30 | `14:30` |
| `url` | `^https?://[^\s/$.?#][^\s]*$` | Enter a full web address starting with https:// | `https://example.com` |
| `uei` | `^[A-Z0-9]{12}$` | A SAM.gov UEI is 12 capital letters and digits | `J7M9HPTGJ1S9` |
| `npi` | `^\d{10}$` | An NPI is ten digits | `1234567893` |
| `icd10` | `^[A-TV-Z]\d[0-9A-Z](\.[0-9A-Z]{1,4})?$` | Enter an ICD-10-CM code in capital letters, for example S93.401A | `S93.401A` |
| `cpt` | `^\d{4}[0-9A-Z]$` | A CPT code is five characters, for example 99213 | `99213` |
| `aNumber` | `^A?\d{7,9}$` | Enter the A-Number as A followed by 7 to 9 digits | `A123456789` |
| `uscis` | `^\d{9}$` | A USCIS number is nine digits | `123456789` |
| `vin` | `^[A-HJ-NPR-Z0-9]{17}$` | A VIN is 17 capital letters and digits (no I, O or Q) | `1HGCM82633A004352` |
| `vinTail` | `^[A-HJ-NPR-Z0-9]{6}$` | Enter the last six characters of the VIN | `A04352` |
| `last4` | `^\d{4}$` | Enter four digits | `6789` |
| `serial` | `^[A-Za-z0-9-]{6,24}$` | Enter the serial as printed on the label: 6 to 24 letters, digits or hyphens | `FT-POS-7A1B2C3D` |
| `sku` | `^[A-Z]{2,4}-[A-Z0-9]{3,10}$` | Enter the SKU as printed on the packing slip, for example POS-T200 | `POS-T200` |
| `gpa4` | `^[0-4](\.\d{1,2})?$` | Enter a GPA from 0.00 to 4.00 | `3.65` |
| `hba1c` | `^\d{1,2}(\.\d)?$` | Enter the HbA1c as a percentage, for example 7.2 | `7.2` |
| `ukDrivingLicence` | `^[A-Z9]{5}\d{6}[A-Z9]{2}\d[A-Z]{2}$` | Enter the 16-character licence number in capital letters | `MORGA753116SM9IJ` |
